description: Retrieve the complete canonical record for a single vehicle by its vehicle_id, 17-character ISO VIN, or pre-1981 vintage chassis/serial number. Returns full specifications, classic_details (era, build_style, numbers_matching, odometer_status), auction_details (if live auction), pricing & fee breakdown, insurance quote payload, all high-res photo URLs, dealer contact info, and source_url.

id_or_vin.description: The canonical vehicle ID (e.g., 'veh_...'), 17-character VIN, or pre-1981 classic chassis/serial number (e.g., 'JS27N0B118261').

name: get_vehicle
title: Get Full Vehicle Details, Classic Provenance & Dealership VDP Info
